entries.label: MGS3 — Lazorevo / fuite à moto
entries.prompt: Create ONE wide 16:9 empty static HD painted 2D fighting stage source for CQC Versus Legacy, based carefully on the attached original-game reference. Preserve each game's specific place, architecture, palette and materials. Continuous horizontal walkable fighting strip at the front. Remove every person, vehicle, HUD, scope reticle, annotation, logo and text. No collage, no spritesheet, no UI. Metal Gear Solid 3 original PS2/HD edition LAZOREVO SOUTH during the motorcycle escape. Use only the game landscape visible inside the scope: grey dusk woodland, enormous rough vertical tree trunks, uneven low grass and rock berms, scattered fallen branches and logs, subdued olive-grey tones, streaks of rain. Extend this into a wide side-on wooded dirt track, clear level muddy foreground path, large dark trunks in middle ground and hazy deeper forest. No cabins, village, river, tropical palms, tall grass field or snowy mountain, no motorcycle or people. No rifle scope circle, red frog marker, HUD or HD Collection logo.

notes: Location and episode checked against the listed screenshot references.
Static painted HD source; perspective, hidden surfaces and fine textures are adapted and not certified as exact 1:1.
No animation, collision layout, parallax separation or runtime admission.
